Sam: Noticed some weirdness in EU edge GPU pct util overnight — dashboards show short 95-100% spikes but aggregate tokens/sec and GPU-hours don't line up. Anyone else seeing this?
Jess: Yep. Pager hit for a 5m saturation window at 03:12 UTC. Metric stream looks noisy.
Kofi: Was just looking. Per-gpu util shows 98% for single-minute bins, but 1h avg is 65%. Could be sampling bias or a redispatch loop.
Sam: Uploading the small dump I pulled from the telemetry. Key bits below.
Sam: ```
2026-03-16T03:11:58Z gpu-rua-12 util_pct=98.7 tokens/sec=18000 inflight=120
2026-03-16T03:12:32Z gpu-rua-12 util_pct=99.1 tokens/sec=4200 inflight=18
2026-03-16T03:13:10Z gpu-rua-12 util_pct=45.2 tokens/sec=17000 inflight=115
```
Jess: That second line is suspicious — util high but tokens/sec low and inflight small. Looks like short blocking on IO or a stall.
OpsBot: ALERT: eu-edge-rua region — gpu-rua-12 transient I/O stalls detected (03:11-03:14 UTC) — 3/3 hosts affected.
Kofi: My hypothesis: small batch tail latency + network egress backpressure. If outgoing RPCs to KV or prefix cache slow, the GPU stays allocated with kernel spinning but not emitting tokens.
Anya: Could also be our per-request prefetch/warmup holding KV lock. We saw similar in q4 but with different fingerprint.
Sam: For capacity forecasting this matters: our headroom calc assumes tokens/sec ~ gpu_util * baseline_tps; these stalls create overestimates of available throughput when using util_pct metrics.
Jess: Actionables: 1) add a tokens/sec fallback metric to headroom calc (avoid relying solely on util_pct) 2) run a micro-sim to see how 1-2 min stall bursts affect 24h GPU-hour projection 3) triage stack traces from the affected hosts.
Kofi: I'll spin up the sim today — will inject 30-120s stalls at 3% of requests and report delta in projected GPU-hours.
Anya: Also recommend increasing metric granularity from 1m to 15s for util_pct during shoulder windows for EU. Might cost more in TS but helpful.
Sam: Good. For forecasting meeting on Monday we should present: - corrected headroom model that prefers tokens/sec during short windows - estimated extra GPU-hours due to stall inflation - a mitigation plan (redispatch thresholds, KV timeout tuning, tiny reserve pool)
Jess: Quick mitigation we can deploy now: set a soft cap that if inflight < 25 and util_pct > 90 for >15s, route 5% traffic to reserve pool. Low risk.
Kofi: I'll prototype the sim and a math sketch: if 3% requests suffer 60s stall, effective throughput drops ~2.5% but util_pct shows +3% for same timeframe -> leads to ~6% overprovision if we react to util.
Sam: Perfect. Assign to Kofi for sim, Jess for short mitigation rollout, Anya for metric config. I'll create the Monday slide with numbers.
OpsBot: NOTE: ticket created INFRA-5342 "EU edge transient GPU stalls — telemetry + mitigations" with priority P2.
Sam: Thanks team. Update in thread when sim results land. :thumbsup:
